source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: resettlement AND (urban OR slum OR city OR "informal settlement")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:resettlement AND (urban OR slum OR city OR "informal settlement"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("resettlement" AND ("informal settlement" OR "city" OR "slum" OR "urban"))
